teaching.author.title: Simulation authoring
teaching.author.notice: Local development only. Compose a guide and simulation using supported templates and apparatus. No scripts or external models run. New instrument behaviour requires an engine extension; this does not enable production publishing.
teaching.author.unavailable: Simulation authoring requires the current development API with local file storage.
teaching.author.label: Display label
teaching.author.valid: Template structure and references pass validation. This does not certify the chemistry.
teaching.author.invalid: Fix validation issues before saving or previewing.
teaching.author.saved_notice: Saved as staged. Editing clears previous local availability and review.
teaching.author.save_failed: The model could not be saved. Check the API, validation and record version. Your edits are retained.
teaching.author.staged: Staged — not in the local library
teaching.author.active: Available in this computer’s local practice library
teaching.author.attest: I reviewed the chemistry, sources, apparatus and both rendered views. This is a local attestation, not authenticated teacher identity.
teaching.author.activate_notice: This affects only the guarded local practice catalog. It does not approve a draft, publish a practical, enable production authentication or make a new physics model.
